excerpt: Not sure what to say to your future self? Here are honest topics, example lines, and questions to make your letter meaningful.

body.text: The blank page can be intimidating. If you've ever wondered what to say to your future self, the answer is simpler than it feels: say what's true for you right now. Here are honest topics and example lines to help you start.
Future you will have forgotten the small, ordinary details — and those are often the most moving to reread.

items: "A normal week for me looks like…"

body.text: You don't have to be wise or polished. Naming your current mood honestly is enough.
Name a hope and a worry
This is the part future you will be most curious about.
If you're in the middle of a decision, write down why you're choosing what you're choosing. Later, this protects you from rewriting the story in hindsight.
Questions turn a letter into a conversation across time.

items: "Did the thing I was worried about actually matter?"
"What do you wish I'd done differently?"

body.text: What you don't need to say
You don't need predictions, big lessons, or perfect grammar. You don't need to sound like anyone but yourself. A short, honest note is more valuable than an impressive one.

When you're ready, seal it and pick a date to reopen. Because PersonalCapsule doesn't collect your capsule text, photos, or voice notes, you can be completely candid about what to say to your future self — it's just for you.
